notes.title: Updates Notes for July 23th
notes.content:
- A new opening cinematic has been added.
 - The zone of the Sledgehammer now resets correctly.
 - Fixed bugs that allowed you to exit the map through areas where you shouldn't.
 - The lights of the doors are shown correctly.
 - Fixed the bug that when crouching and running, the player could get stuck on the ground.
 - Textures that were displayed wrong have been corrected.
 - Fixed areas where you could not climb correctly.
 - It has been corrected the bug in which an enemy did not attack correctly because it was trapped in the wall.
 - The final level has been optimized.
